scope: Fixed current production figure set and existing frozen sources; no new science or change to canonical publication masters.
coordinateConvention: Zero-based x,y; top-left; decoded uint8 RGBA; row-major SHA256.
prerequisites: Every pinned committed source Git blob must be exact. Binary scientific data, source tables and static schematic must be byte-exact; retain existing independent numerical and source-table gates without tolerance.

All native scientific arrays and every accessible/gettable native graphical property must match the persisted canonical readback graph exactly, including axes, limits, labels, legends, styles, ordering and layout. No float tolerance.
Use the exact production lifecycle: saved native FIG readback for Fig6g/h; never compare a pre-readback interaction cache as if it were the exported native instance.

Control runtime figure identities by isolated readback. In both reference and test, drawnow then pf_snapshot before traversing the complete property graph; this materializes lazy empty-axis labels in the same order. Verify actual FileName against its source path before representing only that path as a verified identifier. Serialization UUIDs and handle identities are not scientific payloads; no property differences are silently discarded.

PNG export uses a separate instance; canonical native FIG bytes and original source figures must remain unchanged. Saved/reopened scientific and full graphical content must pass before and after export.
No registration, translation, padding, crop, resize, color transformation, PSNR/RMSE threshold, image-wide tolerance or mask dilation is permitted.
Exact reference dimensions listed per output remain mandatory, including the already documented fixed reproduction dimensions for Fig6a/b/ED7a. This adds no one-pixel dimension exception.

Every assembly image CData must equal its own separately validated source panel PNG exactly; panel identities, object order, axes, annotations, styles and layout remain exact. Only derived raster textures inherit the same fixed edge rule; they cannot bypass it. Original assembly FIG bytes remain protected.
Every original scientific-data image CData, including the static Fig6c schematic, remains exact. Derived composite panel textures are explicitly distinct from scientific numerical arrays.

Use the qualified MATLAB R2025b Update 1 environment and unchanged exportgraphics PNG Resolution=160 settings recorded in evidence. An unqualified environment or any mismatch outside this fixed policy stops release.
acceptance: All prerequisite gates AND all 13 pixel rules must pass. Whole-image hashes need not be previously observed if every changed pixel satisfies its fixed site-specific full RGBA palette and all remaining pixels are exact.
forbidden: No automatic learning or expansion of sites, colors, counts, dimensions, source identities or native-property exceptions. Any new difference is STOP and requires independent diagnosis and explicit new approval.
limitations: Finite bounded evidence cannot guarantee all future renderer states. Previously unobserved coordinates/colors must still stop. No promise of universal bitwise raster determinism.

renderer.RendererDevice: ANGLE (NVIDIA, NVIDIA Quadro RTX 8000 (0x00001E30) Direct3D11 vs_5_0 ps_5_0, D3D11)
